a.lede: Anthropic has officially filed for an IPO, revealing soaring revenue, mounting losses, major enterprise adoption, and an unusual governance structure designed to preserve founder control and its AI safety mission.
a.title: Anthropic officially files for its public debut

b.lede: Anthropic on Monday filed documents ahead of a blockbuster IPO that offers insight into the company’s financials, risk factors, and views on the future of AI.
b.title: Anthropic’s IPO Prospectus Reveals What’s Under the Hood
